candidates.title: Will it rain in New York City on Nov 23, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLINYC in New York City in Nov 23, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:

Data for CLINYC can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will the Republican party win the Senate in 2028?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Republican party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market may be determined early based on a consensus of media calls projecting control of the U.S. Senate. See full rules for details. Otherwise, victory will be determined by the party identification of the President pro tempore of the Senate on February 1, 2029.

candidates.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 27, 2026 be above $1.10?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 27, 2026 is above $1.10, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2027 be above 2.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2027 is above 2.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2027 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2027, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.

candidates.title: Will Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 be above 336.300?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: U.S. city average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–84=100 for November 2026 is above 336.300, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The Underlying is the Bureau of Labor Statistics’ Consumer Price Index News Release Table 1 for November 2026. Specifically, the value used will be the “All items” value under the “Unadjusted indexes” column for November 2026. This market will resolve according to the first value published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the scheduled Consumer Price Index release for November 2026. Subsequent revisions will not affect the market.

candidates.title: Will year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices for November 2026 be above 3.0%?
candidates.rules_primary:
If the year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices for November 2026 is above 

3.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
“Year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices” means the unadjusted 12-month percent change for “Electricity” in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, as published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

Resolution uses the percentage change published in the first BLS CPI release reporting November 2026 data, at its published precision. The value will not be recalculated from index levels. Subsequent revisions will not affect resolution.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate David Malpass as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If David Malpass is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President (or President-elect) of David Malpass's nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.
